source.description: Cosmic chronometers H(z) measurements, Planck 2018 parameters, and Schwarzschild horizon coincidence data

hubble_schwarzschild_coincidence.description: For a spatially flat universe (Omega_tot = 1), the total gravitational mass inside the Hubble sphere equals the mass required for a Schwarzschild black hole of radius R_H.
hubble_schwarzschild_coincidence.significance: Exact mathematical identity: R_s = 2GM/c^2 = 2G (4/3 pi R_H^3 rho_c) / c^2 = (8 pi G rho_c / 3) (R_H^3 / c^2) = (H_0^2) (R_H^3 / c^2) = R_H
